title: DotGothic16
description: A pixel gothic derived from a 16px bitmap. A standard face for retro games, 8-bit, and digital looks. The binary (Regular only, because the face is one weight) is already bundled at assets/font/dotgothic16/ in this repo (added 2026-08-03. The catalog side stays an index, and source below is the fetch record).
when_to_use: Captions for a retro game, an 8-bit look, or a digital or glitch look
ai_usage: ウェイトは用途に応じて選び分けてよい。字間・行間・カラーは overlay/テロップ側で調整してよいが、グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
